SOL:
org 0x7c00              ; BIOS loads the boot sector here
bits 16                 ; 16-bit real mode

start:
    cli
    xor ax, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov sp, 0x7c00
    sti

    mov si, msg0        ; first message
    call print
    mov si, msg1        ; second message
    call print

halt:
    hlt
    jmp halt

print:                  ; prints the zero-terminated string at SI
    mov ah, 0x0e
.next:
    lodsb
    or al, al
    jz .done
    int 0x10
    jmp .next
.done:
    ret

msg0: db 0x0a, 0x0d, "  - Lab 02 - OS -- Fall 2026 -  ", 0
msg1: db 0x0a, 0x0d, "+------------------------------------+"
      db 0x0a, 0x0d, "| Please close the emulator window.  |"
      db 0x0a, 0x0d, "+------------------------------------+", 0

times 510 - ($ - $$) db 0
dw 0xaa55
FL: CPU thread never sleeps: ~100% of 1 core
